# Enclosure vent draft

This abandoned sketch proposed adding a small vent to every AWS enclosure to
reduce condensation around the battery and logger. It was archived before
any field trial because a vent would also create another route for rain,
insects, and wind-driven damp.

## Original idea

The draft placed a covered opening low on the enclosure and a second opening
higher up, intending to let warm air leave during sunny periods. The proposal
assumed that a dry station enclosure would stay dry through airflow alone.

## Why it stopped

The volunteer group agreed that gasket checks, cable-gland inspection, and
desiccant replacement are easier to inspect and reverse. No enclosure should
be drilled using this draft. Keep it only as a record of the rejected vent
approach.
